crew.overview: Though young Jane Austen's financially strapped parents expect her to marry the nephew of wealthy Lady Gresham, Jane herself knows that such a union will destroy her creativity and sense of self-worth. Instead, she becomes involved with Tom Lefroy, a charming but penniless apprentice lawyer who gives her the knowledge of the heart she needs for her future career as a novelist.
crew.title: Becoming Jane

details.biography: Nicole Finnan is an Executive Producer for film and television. She started her career at KPMG, followed by ten years at Ecosse Films and two years at Ruby Films. She joined Eleventh Hour Films in 2011.
details.name: Nicole Finnan
